Fructify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹbahuPaladIkf 8 U, saPalIkf, sPItIkf, saPalayati (D.).

Frugal,Ⓒa.Ⓓmita-alpa-vyaya-vyayin, svalpa-parimita-vyaya, amuktahasta, kfpaRa, vyayavimuKa.
Ⓝ[Frugal]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹmitavyayitA, mita-svalpa-vyayaH, amuktahastatvaM, kfpaRatvaM.
Ⓝ[Frugal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹamuktahastaM; mita-svalpa-vyayena, alpavyayapUrvaM, kfpaRaM.

Fruit,Ⓒs.ⒹPalaM (lit. and fig.); Sa(sa)syaM, prasa-vaH, utpannaM.
Ⓑ
 2 pariRAmaH, uttaraPalaM, karmaPalaM.
Ⓑ
 3 (Progeny) apatyaM, saMtAnaH-naM, saMtati f., prajA, prasUti f.; PalaM.
Ⓑ
 4 arTaH, lABaH, Pa-lAgamaH, PalaprApti f., ‘dry f(ruit)’ vAnaM; ‘unripe f(ruit)’ SalAwu; ‘bear f(ruit)’ Pal 1 P, PalaM baMD 9 P or dA 3 U, saPalIBU, pac pass., (sadya eva sukftAM hi pacyate kAMkzitaM R. xi. 50); ‘f(ruit)-bearer’ PaladAtf m., PaladaH; ‘f(ruit)-bearing’ Palada, Palegrahi, PalaBft, PaladA-yin, Palin, PalaSAlin; ‘f(ruit)-garden’ Pala-vAwaH-wikA; ‘f(ruit)-season or -time’ Pala-kAlaH-samayaH, PalAvacayakAlaH; ‘f(ruit)-stalk or -stem’ SasyamaMjarI, prasavabaMDanaM, vfMtaM; ‘f(ruit) tree’ PaladaH vfkzaH or vanaspatiH, PalagrAhin m.
Ⓝ[Fruit]age,Ⓒs.ⒹPaloccayaH, PalaBAraH-gucCaH, Pa-lAgamaH.
Ⓝ[Fruit]erer,Ⓒs.ⒹPalavikrayin m.
Ⓝ[Fruit]ery,Ⓒs.ⒹPalAni (pl.).
Ⓑ
 2 PalasTAnaM.
Ⓝ[Fruit]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹPalavat, Palada, Palin, saPala, Palita, avaMDya, amoGa, bahuPalada, Palina, Palegrahi.
Ⓑ
 2 bahupraja, prajanizRu, bahvapatya, bahuprajopeta.
Ⓑ
 3 utpAdaka, janaka; Avaha-praBavaH-mUlaM-kAraRaM in comp.
Ⓝ[Fruit]less,Ⓒa.ⒹnizPala, vi-a-Pala, nirarTaka, vyarTa, moGa, vaMDya, anarTaka, nizprayojana, nirguRa, anupayukta, PalahIna, avakeSin.
Ⓝ[Fruit]lessly,Ⓒadv.ⒹvyarTaM, nirarTakaM, muDA, vfTA, moGaM, ni-zPalaM.
Ⓝ[Fruit]lessness,Ⓒs.ⒹvEyarTyaM, anupayogaH, vyarTatA, vEPalyaM.
ⓃFruition,Ⓒs.Ⓓupa-, BogaH, Bukti f., anuBavaH, AsvAdaH; suKopaBogaH, PalAsvAdaH, suKAnuBavaH, suKAsvAdaH.

Frustrate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹviPalI-nizPalI-moGI-kf 8 U, prati-vyA-han 2 P, BaMj 7 P, KaMq 10, vfTA-muDA-kf; See Baffle.
Ⓔa.ⒹFruitless, q. v.

Ⓝ[Frustrat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹBaMgaH, vyAGAtaH, viPalIkaraRaM, KaMqanaM.
Ⓝ[Frustrat]ive, [Frustrat]ory,Ⓒa.ⒹvyAGAtin, BaMjaka, vfTAkArin.
